vacuum_policy: cleaning=start; idle=return_to_base/stop fallback; capability-gated; physical experiments blocked
manual_feedback: one explicit wrong-agent-action correction; -1 rejected prediction/action +1 corrected value; physical/UI equivalent
manual_feedback_ui: Always-visible Naucz (Desired only) and Naucz / popraw (physical Current correction)
manual_feedback_context: bounded full eligible HA context snapshot on every manual correction; supervised relevance can promote previously unselected entities
manual_feedback_schema: online schema rotation preserves matching feature weights and fixed home-intelligence slots
manual_feedback_safety: manual correction is blocked from mutating policy during historical training; autonomous Control gates remain unchanged
desired_teaching: persistent contextual labels; reject prediction and reinforce desired; no direct HA call, manual hold, or pending-action reward
agent_rendering: event-time renderer dispatch; stable card ownership by normalized agent ID
